title: What is an API? A plain answer for owners | 50agents
description: An API is the set of requests an app accepts from other software, like "list last week's payments". Why it decides what you can connect and automate.
definition: An API is the published set of requests an app accepts from other software, such as "list last week's payments".
With one, tools read and change its data without opening its screens.

example.ask: Set up an AI agent that reads last week's payments in Stripe every Monday at 9:00 and emails me the totals and what changed
example.why: It asks Stripe's API for the payments as data, never opening the dashboard.

build.name: Monday revenue
build.line: last week in Stripe, in one email
does: Reads last week's payments in Stripe
Compares them with the week before
Emails you the totals and what changed
